trigger.input: Preserved When_an_item_is_created_or_modified / GetOnUpdatedItems, one-minute polling, splitOn body/value, triggerBody()['ID']; site/list match current source Get_item.
trigger.authoritativeProfile: Read current saved item, not stale trigger field values

rules.requiredAccount: Existing nonblank single Person lookup; never resolve or rewrite identity
rules.optionalTimezone: Blank allowed; a supplied lookup must resolve to an active Timezone catalog item
rules.catalogues: Each supplied positive integer lookup ID must exist in its exact mapped list and be Active=true
rules.availability: ParticipationStatus and OpenToConnections never affect validation; never reset them
rules.specialValues: Any language is an existing active catalogue item; do not interpret its key as an ID or a validator bypass

failureContract.failedRead: Explicit failed run; do not treat unavailable/malformed/incomplete reads as empty catalogues or success
failureContract.concurrentEdit: Exact current-item ETag used in IF-MATCH on Status-only POST/MERGE; retries disabled. HTTP 412 fails run; later event reads current data. No stale overwrite or success report.
failureContract.postWrite: Read back and verify Status without claiming unrelated fields were written
failureContract.selfTrigger: Follow-up reads current item and skips unchanged Status; no sustained loop
